evidence.claim: The second-generation fraud model scored transaction 3524668 at 0.992, with past transactions in this score bucket showing a 92.1% confirmed fraud rate.
Card C09616-K1 was subject to confirmed fraud in closed case CC-2294 on 2016-08-18 ($100.02), where the cardholder reported unauthorized online use and the card was confirmed compromised.
The holder identity for transaction 3524668 has zero prior transactions, offering no baseline of normal cardholder behavior and no recurring payment match.
Transaction 3524668 was conducted on device D000431, which has a generic Windows Edge profile seen across 135 cards prior to the alert, operating without a proxy and with ring ID -1.
Card C09616-K1 belongs to Louvain community 96469293 with 41 cards and a 22% fraud rate, representing a weak 2.2x lift over the baseline card fraud rate.
Transaction 3524668 is an isolated $49.92 purchase with no preceding micro-authorization card-testing sequence or immediate rapid velocity burst.
Billing region 476 had 318 transactions in the 7-day window with only 2 scoring over 0.5, giving an exculpatory fraud lift of 0.30 relative to baseline.
The transaction was detected through automated model monitoring rather than an inbound customer denial or dispute.

case.summary: Transaction 3524668 for $49.92 on card C09616-K1 was flagged by monitoring after the second-generation fraud model assigned it a score of 0.992 (calibrated historical fraud rate of 92.1%), despite a low legacy risk score of 0.30. Investigation revealed that card C09616-K1 was previously confirmed compromised in closed case CC-2294 following an unauthorized transaction in August 2016. Furthermore, the cardholder possesses no legitimate transaction baseline or recurring history on this card to support the charge. Although the transaction was an isolated charge from a generic device profile, unauthorized online activity on an already compromised card confirms card-not-present fraud. The transaction is deemed fraudulent, and the card has been blocked with an investigation case opened.

stop_reason: The investigation stopped pursuant to policy section 6 because the fraud probability reached 0.937, well above the decisive threshold of 0.85, established by two independent strong evidentiary bases including a calibrated model score and confirmed prior compromise on the card, meaning further investigative steps would not alter the decision.
